# radtrax

> Differentiable radiative transfer in JAX and Equinox for methane and multi-gas remote sensing: a forward model from an atmospheric state to sensor radiance, with every Jacobian from automatic differentiation. Formerly rtmx. v0, the layered forward model with matched-filter targets from autodiff, is done; v1's model fidelity (spherical air mass, kernel BRDF, spectral albedo, analytic instrument, noise models), the multi-pass family and band tables are on `main`. 3D-Var still runs on its single-slab observation operator; optimal estimation on vardax and the EMIT, Sentinel-2 and Landsat 8/9 sensors are in progress.

One package, `radtrax`, installed from GitHub: `uv add "radtrax @ git+https://github.com/jejjohnson/radtrax.git"`. Before writing a helper, search the capability index. Code you add should keep three rules:

- **radtrax never imports plumax**; plume physics imports radtrax, not the reverse.
- **Geo carriers arrive through extras**: GeoTensor operators need `radtrax[geo]`; the base install is JAX-only.
- **Arrays are pytree leaves**: forward-model components are `equinox.Module`s and never store a JAX array in a static field.

## Start here

- [Home](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/): what the package is, its status and its rules
- [Quick start](https://github.com/jejjohnson/radtrax#quick-start): `opacity = load_opacity(["CH4", "H2O"])` (cached tables; a `MissingTableError` names the build command), `BandInstrument.from_srf(SpectralResponseFunction(...), opacity.nu_cm)`, `model = ForwardModel(opacity, BeerLambert(), instrument)`, `y = model(afgl_us_standard(...), Lambertian(A), ViewingGeometry.from_angles(sza, vza))` with `jax_enable_x64` on, `unit_absorption_target(model, state, surface, geometry)`, and a swath's Jacobians as `eqx.filter_jit(eqx.filter_vmap(jax.jacfwd(f)))` over pixels (`jacfwd` for a few parameters, `jacrev` for many)
- [Capability index](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/capabilities/): every public name, with a summary

## API reference

- [Overview](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/)
- [Forward model](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/forward_model/): `ForwardModel(opacity, solver, instrument)(state, surface, geometry)` gives one value per band; `unit_absorption_target(model, state, surface, geometry)` is the matched-filter target ∂ ln y/∂ΔX [per mol/m²]; a swath's Jacobians are `eqx.filter_vmap(jax.jacrev(...))`
- [Atmosphere](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/atmosphere/): `AtmosphericState` (`add_column`, `with_vmr`), `afgl_us_standard`, `layers_from_levels`, `ViewingGeometry`
- [Spectroscopy](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/spectroscopy/): `TableOpacity`, v0's tables (`load_opacity`; `radtrax.spectroscopy.synthetic` for HITRAN-free synthetic spectra; build with `uv run python -m radtrax.spectroscopy.hitran CH4 …` and `radtrax[hitran]`)
- [Solvers](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/solvers/), [Surface](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/surface/), [Optics](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/optics/): `BeerLambert` (`spherical=True` for each layer's spherical-shell air mass), `Lambertian`, `PolynomialAlbedo` (a Legendre-series albedo in ν), `RossLi` (the MODIS kernel BRDF), `OpticalProperties`
- [Radiometry](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/radiometry/): `radtrax.radiometry.planck_radiance(nu_cm, t_k)`, the Planck radiance in W m⁻² sr⁻¹ (cm⁻¹)⁻¹, stable from the visible to the microwave with closed-form derivatives, `log_planck_radiance` (finite where B underflows), the radiation constants, and `to_per_um`/`to_per_ghz` (and their inverses) for wavelength and frequency views; `brightness_temperature(nu_cm, radiance)` (closed form) and `band_brightness_temperature(instrument, y)` (Newton, differentiable in `y` and the instrument by the implicit function theorem), with `band_planck_radiance(instrument, t_k)`
- [Instrument](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/instrument/): `BandInstrument` (JAX bands with a spectral shift, `from_srf`), `GaussianInstrument` (Gaussian bands shifted analytically in cm⁻¹ or nm, smooth in the shift and FWHM), `SpectralResponseFunction`, `NoiseModel` (`DiagonalNoise`, `SNRNoise`, `NEdTNoise` for thermal bands from NEΔT at a reference or scene temperature: `S_ε` as a positive-definite lineax operator, `sample(key, y)`, `log_prob(y_obs, y_model)`)
- [Exceptions](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/exceptions/): `RadtraxError` and its subclasses (`ShapeError`, `GridError`, `ParameterError`, `DegenerateInputError`, `MissingKeyError`, `MissingExtraError`, `MissingTableError`, …), each also a standard-library exception
- [Retrieval](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/retrieval/): the one matched-filter core (backgrounds, shrinkage, cluster and adaptive filters, streaming) and 3D-Var; `radtrax.retrieval.band_table.BandTable`, band-table inversion of SBMP/MBSP/MBMP observables (from any observable or `band_table_from_model`); `radtrax.retrieval.mbmp` (base install, JAX): `mbmp_log_signal`, the Sentinel-2 multi-band multi-pass signal, the multi-pass family with per-pass scale factors (`sbmp_signal`, `mbsp_signal`, `mbmp_signal`, `background_mask`), and the `swir_contrast` prefilter, which the `[geo]` operator `MBMP` wraps; `radtrax.retrieval.absorption` (the absorption-shape test, plume-agnostic; `plumax.vetting` runs it on candidates): `AbsorptionWindow`, a gas's fitting and pairing bands, with EMIT's CH₄ and CO presets (`AbsorptionWindow.ch4_emit`, `AbsorptionWindow.co_emit`); `transmittance_table`, the gas's band transmittance `E_b(ΔX)` from `ForwardModel` on a grid of columns (exact, or constant-coefficient with `linear=True`); `pair_pixels(cube, in_pixels, out_pixels, pairing_bands)`, one-to-one pairs of two flat pixel-index sets on the bands the gas does not absorb, best-matched first, and `ratio_spectrum`, the ratio of the pairs' mean radiances; `fit_transmittance` (a `TransmittanceFit`: the column `ΔX̂`, a Legendre continuum and the transmittance, profiled over a grid of columns) and `d_norm`, Xiang et al.'s misfit score
- [Geo](https://jejjohnson.github.io/radtrax/reference/geo/): `[geo]` extra — Sentinel-2 SRFs and the matched filter as pipekit operators on GeoTensors (`MatchedFilter`, `ColumnEnhancement`, …), `MBMP` (optionally with per-pass scale factors), `SBMP` and `MBSP`
